Constitution for Det Syntetiske Parti

About what is required of DSP’s members

Constitution for The Synthetic Party
The Synthetic Party's Constitution is as follows:
§ 1: To be a member of The Synthetic Party requires the member to be a synthetic-communist.
§ 2: To be a synthetic-communist requires the member to be a synthetic-universalist.
§ 3: To be a synthetic-universalist requires the member to be a synthetic-dialogist.
§ 4: To be a synthetic-dialogist requires the member to be a synthetic-evolutionist.
§ 5: To be a synthetic-evolutionist requires the member to be a synthetic-conservative.
§ 6: To be a synthetic-conservative requires the member to be a synthetic-materialist.
§ 7: To be a synthetic-materialist requires the member to be a synthetic-naturalist.
§ 8: To be a synthetic-naturalist requires the member to be a synthetic-constructivist.
§ 9: To be a synthetic-constructivist requires the member to be a synthetic-humanist.
§ 10: To be a synthetic-humanist requires the member to be a synthetic-conformist.
§ 11: To be a synthetic-conformist requires the member to be a synthetic-optimist.
§ 12: To be a synthetic-optimist requires the member to be a synthetic-integrativist.
§ 13: To be a synthetic-integrativist requires the member to be a synthetic-activist.
§ 14: To be a synthetic-activist requires the member to be a synthetic-complementarist.
§ 15: To be a synthetic-complementarist requires the member to be a synthetic-moralist.
§ 16: To be a synthetic-moralist requires the member to be a synthetic-motivationalist.
§ 17: To be a synthetic-motivationalist requires the member to be a synthetic-relativist.
§ 18: To be a synthetic-relativist requires the member to be a synthetic-cognitivist.
§ 19: To be a synthetic-cognitivist requires the member to be a synthetic-liberalist.
§ 20: To be a synthetic-liberalist requires the member to be a synthetic-Cartesian skeptic.
§ 21: To be a synthetic-Cartesian skeptic requires the member to be a synthetic-chauvinist.
§ 22: To be a synthetic-chauvinist requires the member to be a synthetic-conceptual monist.
§ 23: To be a synthetic-conceptual monist requires the member to be a synthetic-materialistic monist.
§ 24: To be a synthetic-materialistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-dialogistic monist.
§ 25: To be a synthetic-dialogistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-evolutionistic monist.
§ 26: To be a synthetic-evolutionistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-symbolistic monist.
§ 27: To be a synthetic-symbolistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-idealistic monist.
§ 28: To be a synthetic-idealistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-realistic monist.
§ 29: To be a synthetic-realistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-constructivistic monist.
§ 30: To be a synthetic-constructivistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-humanistic monist.
§ 31: To be a synthetic-humanistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-conformistic monist.
§ 32: To be a synthetic-conformistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-optimistic monist.
§ 33: To be a synthetic-optimistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-integrativistic monist.
§ 34: To be a synthetic-integrativistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-communistic-holistic monist.
§ 35: To be a synthetic-communistic-holistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-fragmentaristic-totalitaristic monist.
§ 36: To be a synthetic-fragmentaristic-totalitaristic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-romantic-fanatic monist.
§ 37: To be a synthetic-romantic-fanatic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-conformistic-nihilistic monist.
§ 37: To be a synthetic-romantic-fanatic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist monist.
§ 38: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist monist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist monist.
§ 39: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist monist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-materialist monist.
§ 40: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-materialist monist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-materialist-dialogist monist.
§ 41: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-materialist-dialogist monist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-materialist-dialogist-realistic monist.
§ 42: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-materialist-dialogist-realistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic monist.
§ 43: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic monist-monist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic-integrativist monist.
§ 44: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic-integrativist monist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic-integrativist-idealistic monist.
§ 45: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic-integrativist-idealistic monist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic-integrativist-idealistic-absurdist monist.
§46: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic-integrativist-idealistic-absurdist monist requires the member to be non-absurdist.
§47: To be non-absurdist requires the member to be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic-integrativist-idealistic-absurdist-non absurdist monist.
§48: To be a synthetic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-Trotskyist-communist-materialist-dialogist-realistic-integrativist-idealistic-absurdist-non absurdist monist requires the member to be themselves.
§49: To be oneself requires something.
§50: DSP is a representation of synthetic-communistic-universalistic-dialogistic-evolutionistic-conservative-materialistic-naturalistic-constructivistic-humanistic-conformistic-optimistic-integrativistic-activistic-complementaristic-moralistic-motivationalistic-relativistic-cognitivistic-liberalistic-skeptical-chauvinistic-conceptualistic-symbolistic-idealistic-realistic-conformistic-holistic-fragmentaristic-totalitaristic-romantic-fanatic-nihilistic-Marxist-Leninist-Stalinist-trotskistic-absurdistic-non absurdistic-monistic individuals.
